# inria.hal.science

> Inria's HAL open-access repository for research publications, technical reports, and scientific outputs with comprehensive guides for authors and researchers.

inria.hal.science is the French National Institute for Research in Digital Science and Technology's institutional repository on the HAL (Hyper Articles en Ligne) platform. It provides open access to Inria research publications, technical reports, and source code while offering extensive documentation for researchers on publication management, open science practices, and repository best practices.

## Key Topics

- HAL Open Archive
- Open Access
- Scientific Publishing

## Core Resources

- [Home - Inria - Institut national de recherche en sciences et technologies du numérique](https://inria.hal.science): Inria's HAL open-access repository homepage for research publications
- [Home - Rapports de recherche et Technique de l'Inria](https://inria.hal.science/INRIA-RRRT): Inria research and technical reports collection in HAL repository
- [inria-open-science1 - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/inria-open-science1): Inria's open science policy and Creative Commons licensing mandate

## Author Guides & Setup

- [affilier-portail-inria - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/affilier-portail-inria): Guide for author affiliation and IdHAL profile setup in HAL
- [version-depot - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/version-depot): HAL deposit policy and author version guidelines for publications
- [deposer-vos-codes-sources - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/deposer-vos-codes-sources): Guide for depositing source code via Software Heritage and HAL

## Publication Management & Optimization

- [optimiser-depots - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/optimiser-depots): Best practices guide for optimizing HAL repository submissions
- [mettre-en-valeur-ses-publications - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/mettre-en-valeur-ses-publications): Guide for highlighting publications using HAL and Haltools
- [ajouter-des-vignettes - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/ajouter-des-vignettes): Guide for adding thumbnails and images to HAL publications

## Profile & Collection Customization

- [personnaliser-cvhal - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/personnaliser-cvhal): Tutorial for customizing CV-HAL profile styling and appearance
- [creer-personnaliser-collection - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/creer-personnaliser-collection): Tutorial for creating and customizing HAL portal collections

## Statistics & Accessibility

- [statistiques-publications-inria-in-hal - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/statistiques-publications-inria-in-hal): Publication metrics and download statistics for Inria in HAL
- [umbrhal-inria-accessibilite - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/umbrhal-inria-accessibilite): Accessibility guide for Umbrhal dark mode and browser extensions

## News & Updates

- [actualites-inria - Inria](https://inria.hal.science/page/actualites-inria): News and updates on HAL policies, arXiv changes, and guidelines
